remaining_reasons: Restore the source's strict left-facing head profile and gaze with only the source-visible eye. The raw turns the mascot toward a three-quarter view and adds a second far-side green-ringed eye at the left facial silhouette, changing the clearly visible one-eye profile composition.

Restore the source-visible dark eyebrow and the short brown hair behind the original ear/sideburn area. The raw has a bare yellow brow and smooth rear head side. Retain the covered upper hairline and do not substitute a human ear for the missing hair.

Remove the binoculars added at the bottom center of the raw. The exact source's lower chest contains the dark uniform and existing straps but no binoculars; preserve the original uniform, strap layout and crop without the new accessory.
Restore the neck cross to the source's black-and-white appearance. The raw gives the cross a clearly visible red center that is absent from the source.

hair_features.reason: The source-visible dark eyebrow and short brown rear/sideburn hair are absent from the raw's smooth yellow face and rear head side.

entries.positive_observation: The compact yellow mascot has green-ringed solid black eyes, exactly one closed mouth, no human skin, nose or ears, no glasses, and no moustache or beard. The grey-olive peaked cap retains its brown band, dark visor, gold-toned eagle, wreath/cockade and gold piping/cords as visible principal groups. The dark olive uniform retains red gold-embroidered collar tabs, pale metallic shoulder boards, a light grey-blue pointed shirt collar, dark tie and the existing strap layout. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without pinching, floating cloth or a cream bib. The pale warm grey-beige backplate remains complete and opaque across the full canvas with its soft mottling and edge shading; no frame, note, cutout or halo was added. Full raw and white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes or backing loss.
entries.alpha_decision: The exact source is fully opaque RGBA with measured alpha extrema [255,255]. The unchanged raw is RGB with returned_alpha_extrema null, as declared by the opaque working-pass prompt; full raw and white/cyan/source-alpha comparisons show no visible hole or lost backing. No alpha repair was performed. The visible RGB profile, hair, binocular and neck-cross defects prevent approval for production or for a subsequent source-alpha BILINEAR repair step.
entries.visible_limitations: At 156x210 the exact small cap-badge shapes and fine collar/shoulder embroidery cannot be separated reliably; those fine-detail limits are not rejection grounds. The rejection rests on the clearly visible two-eye profile change, missing brow/side hair, added binoculars and red cross center, not on unreadable embroidery or alpha values.
